name: since_close_served_surfaces_20261109
comment: LQ-20261107-1672 (operator 14:39 ET): Home's 'Your actions' (AS OF 2:16 PM), 'Do now 1 of 5',
'Protect 5 stop changes' and 'Stops 5 to decide' told the operator to raise SPCX (IRA and taxable),
ANET and SKYD while stop_last_known showed exactly those stops WORKING. Every one of those surfaces
reads the same overnight brief, written before the broker's book moved. Pins: served_since_close()
returns the same brief with each stop_advice row reconciled against the passed stop read and the
stop_read clock beside it, mutating neither the input document nor any other brief key;
reconcile_stop_surfaces() returns the counts those surfaces print (actions / settled / quiet / total,
status open|unread|done|quiet) and the one line a satisfied ask moves to ('No change needed — done at
Schwab (stop time)'); an unread book marks every ask unread, claims no stop time and prints no done line;
a snapshot with no brief is served unchanged; the surfaces call the brief's own reconcile_stop_advice,
so there is one rule, not one per route. Synthetic ZQ* fixtures; the real snapshot is never touched.
